Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Management Consultant with Digital Banking expertise to support strategic transformation initiatives across our banking clients. You will work with senior client stakeholders to assess existing digital banking capabilities, identify strategic opportunities and gaps, evaluate future-state options, and translate these into clear recommendations and actionable transformation roadmaps. Depending on the engagement, this may include reviewing a bank's digital portfolio, customer propositions, channels, capabilities, operating model, technology landscape and market footprint, and defining how these should evolve to support future business priorities. This is a strategy and advisory-focused role rather than a traditional project delivery position. You should be comfortable working with ambiguous problems, structuring complex questions, conducting analysis, challenging existing thinking and communicating clear recommendations to senior executives. What You'll Do Digital Banking Strategy Support the development and refinement of digital banking strategies aligned to business priorities, customer needs and market developments. Assess existing digital propositions, channels, products, capabilities and initiatives. Identify strategic gaps, overlaps, opportunities and areas requiring further investment or rationalization. Evaluate how digital capabilities should evolve to support future business and customer needs. Assess strategic options and articulate the associated benefits, trade-offs, risks and implications. Current-State & Capability Assessment Conduct structured assessments of the bank's current digital landscape and capabilities. Assess capabilities across areas such as customer journeys, digital channels, products, processes, data, technology and operating models. Develop current-state and future-state capability views. Identify gaps between existing capabilities and the desired strategic direction. Conduct market, competitor and industry analysis where relevant to inform recommendations. Target State & Roadmap Development Define future-state digital banking capabilities, propositions and operating direction. Translate strategic recommendations into practical and prioritized transformation roadmaps. Define initiatives, sequencing, dependencies and key implementation considerations. Support development of business cases and investment priorities. Ensure recommendations consider both business ambition and technology feasibility. Structured Problem Solving & Analysis Structure complex and ambiguous business questions into clear hypotheses, analytical frameworks and workstreams. Conduct qualitative and quantitative analysis to test hypotheses and identify insights. Synthesize information from multiple sources into clear findings and implications. Develop strategic options and evaluate them against agreed criteria. Translate analysis into practical recommendations rather than simply presenting findings. Senior Stakeholder Engagement Conduct interviews, workshops and working sessions with senior stakeholders across business, digital, product, technology and operations. Facilitate discussions to understand strategic priorities, challenges and constraints. Build alignment around future-state recommendations and transformation priorities. Challenge stakeholder thinking constructively and bring an independent consulting perspective. Operate confidently with senior executives across complex stakeholder environments. Executive Storytelling & Consulting Delivery Develop high-quality executive presentations, strategy papers and recommendation decks. Build clear storylines that connect analysis, insights, implications and recommendations. Communicate complex concepts simply and effectively to senior audiences. Produce consulting-quality deliverables with strong attention to structure, logic and detail. Contribute to Capco propositions, thought leadership and business development activities. What We're Looking For Experience within management consulting, strategy consulting, business consulting or strategic advisory, ideally within financial services. Demonstrated experience working on digital banking strategy, banking transformation or related strategic initiatives. Strong understanding of the banking landscape and how digital capabilities support business and customer outcomes. Experience conducting current-state assessments, capability assessments, strategic reviews, target-state definition and/or roadmap development. Strong structured problem-solving and analytical capabilities. Ability to take an ambiguous problem and develop a structured approach to answering it. Experience evaluating strategic options and developing practical recommendations. Excellent executive storylining, presentation and slide-writing capabilities. Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills, including experience engaging senior executives. Ability to understand and connect business strategy, customer needs, operating models and technology capabilities. Relevant Digital Banking Experience Experience across one or more areas such as: Digital Banking Strategy Mobile & Online Banking Digital Customer Journeys Digital Products & Propositions Digital Channels Payments Digital Wealth / Private Banking Customer Onboarding / eKYC Open Banking / APIs Data & Personalisation Digital Operating Models Platform / Technology Modernisation Candidates do not need experience across every area; we are looking for a combination of strong consulting capability and meaningful digital banking domain expertise. Advantageous Experience Previous experience with a management consulting or strategy consulting firm. Experience working directly with banks on regional or multi-market strategy engagements. Exposure to Asian banking markets and digital banking ecosystems. Experience developing business cases, investment cases or transformation portfolios. Experience across both business and technology strategy. Mandarin and/or Cantonese proficiency would be advantageous where relevant to client requirements.

title: RevOps Systems Administrator (Salesforce)
description: Xendit provides payment infrastructure across Southeast Asia and is expanding to Greater China and LATAM. We process payments, power marketplaces, disburse payroll and loans, provide KYC solutions, prevent fraud, and help businesses grow exponentially. We serve our customers by providing a suite of world-class APIs, eCommerce platform integrations, and easy to use applications for individual entrepreneurs, SMEs, and enterprises alike. Our main focus is building the most advanced payment rails for Southeast Asia, with a clear goal in mind — to make payments across and within SEA simple, secure and easy for everyone. We serve thousands of businesses ranging from SMEs to multinational enterprises, and process millions of transactions monthly. We’ve been growing rapidly since our inception in 2015, onboarding hundreds of new customers every month, and backed by global top-10 VCs . We’re proud to be featured on among the fastest growing companies by Y-Combinator . About the Team The RevOps Systems team owns Salesforce and the broader ecosystem of systems that power Xendit's revenue engine — from lead-to-cash to the tools that plug into it. As the team scales to support both net-new projects and the steady drumbeat of platform improvements, we're adding a role dedicated to keeping the Salesforce platform and all its integrated systems of actions healthy and continuously improving. About the Role This is a hands-on administrator role for all sales tools, primarily but not limited to Salesforce CRM. You'll be the day-to-day owner of the GTM platform — performing basic systems configuration yourself, and leading Continuous Improvement (CI) as a structured sprint cadence rather than an ad hoc ticket queue. You'll run CI sprint planning and prioritization, resolve declarative work directly (Flow, validation rules, page layouts, reports, permission sets), and package anything that needs custom development for our two Salesforce Engineers. You'll work closely with the CRM Transformation Lead and the Engineers, keeping the platform's ongoing enhancements moving with a predictable rhythm. Responsibilities Lead Continuous Improvement sprints: own the CI backlog and co-run it with the CRM Transformation Lead as a sprint cadence — planning, prioritization, and review — so ongoing platform enhancements have a predictable rhythm instead of ad hoc firefighting. Perform basic Salesforce configuration: build and maintain Flow Builder automation, validation rules, permission sets and sharing rules, page layouts, and reports/dashboards. Manage other Salesforce integrated Sales tools (e.g. DealOps, Gong.io, DocuSign, Spotdraft): to take-over the maintenance of sales tools post successful project implementation, to perform basic platform configuration, engagement with 3rd party vendor’s CSM if required during implementation of new enhancements. Triage and scope enhancement requests: intake requests from Sales, CS, Finance, and other stakeholders; resolve what's declarative yourself, and write clear specs for anything that needs the Salesforce Engineers to build. Maintain platform health: monitor data quality, user access, and adoption across Salesforce and all integrated platforms, and proactively flag risks or technical debt before they become incidents. Partner with Salesforce Engineers: keep the CI sprint board unblocked, coordinate handoffs on items that need custom development, and run UAT on what Engineering ships. Support project delivery: assist the CRM Transformation Lead and Engineers on larger project rollouts with configuration, testing, and UAT support. Maintain documentation and governance: keep configurations, processes, and decisions documented so platform knowledge doesn't live in one person's head. Minimum qualifications 2–5 years of experience as a Salesforce Administrator or in a similar hands-on platform administration role. Hands-on proficiency with declarative Salesforce configuration — Flow Builder, validation rules, permission sets and sharing rules, page layouts, reports and dashboards. Experience running or contributing to sprint-based delivery — backlog grooming, sprint planning, and retros. Comfortable triaging and prioritizing a live queue of enhancement requests from multiple stakeholders at once. Clear written and verbal communication — you can explain a configuration trade-off to a non-technical stakeholder and write a spec an engineer can build from. Comfortable operating with a small team, holding ambiguity, and making prioritization calls independently. Experience in performing systems configuration for Salesforce integrated 3rd party platforms. Comfortable and proactive in engaging 3rd party vendor CSMs when required during implementation of new enhancements. Preferred qualifications Salesforce Administrator certification (or equivalent hands-on experience). Experience with agile/backlog tooling (e.g. Jira, Asana, Linear) and running sprint or Kanban-style delivery cadences. Exposure to RevOps or GTM processes specifically — lead-to-cash, quote-to-cash, or billing/collections workflows. Prior experience in fintech, payments, or another regulated, fast-scaling environment. Success in the First 6 Months Looks Like CI runs on a predictable sprint cadence, with a groomed backlog and visible velocity from sprint to sprint. The majority of CI tickets are resolved through direct configuration, without needing Engineer involvement. Salesforce Engineers report a measurable drop in time spent on ticket triage, freeing them to focus on project and architecture work. Configuration standards and a change log are documented and kept current. Successful take-over post deployment of integrated sales tools from the enablement wing of RevOps.

title: AI Engineer, Knowledge Infrastructure
description: This is Adyen Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. Documentation Tooling Team The Documentation Tooling Team is responsible for building the systems and foundations that improve how technical knowledge is created, structured, and delivered across Adyen’s developer ecosystem. You will work on core challenges related to content quality, freshness, consistency, scalability and the ability to make information usable both for people and agents. In this role, you will build the next generation of Adyen’s knowledge platform. This platform turns static documentation into structured, queryable knowledge.This includes structuring content, connecting content from multiple sources and building interfaces that make technical documentation accessible across products and tools as knowledge. Your work will power reliable, contextual and efficient access to information for customers, developers, AI agents and internal teams. The team is a strategic part of the Developer Experience group within the Customer Experience solution. Our mission is to provide clear, accurate, and accessible knowledge that supports customers throughout their integration journey and helps them move quickly with confidence. Core Focus Area Content Architecture: Design scalable graph schemas, ontologies, and metadata models that support consistency, reuse, and discoverability across documentation. Serverless Pipeline Orchestration: Own, configure, and optimize robust AWS serverless pipelines to ingest and process documentation from distributed sources. Knowledge Systems Design: Design structured knowledge representations that allow information to be connected, navigated and queried programmatically. APIs for Knowledge & AI Access: Build high-performance retrieval interfaces optimized for developer environments and AI agents. Instrumentation and Quality: Implement automated controls and validation rules to detect documentation drift and ensure the long-term integrity of the knowledge platform. What You’ll Do Implement and deliver the next generation of Adyen’s Knowledge platform, establishing the foundation for intelligent and contextual knowledge delivery via AI native interfaces. Design, configure and orchestrate serverless pipelines in AWS to ingest content from headless CMS and Git repositories. Define the graph schemas, ontologies, and write highly optimized, idempotent queries to update and query the graph database. Collaborate Cross-Functionally working closely with technical writers, product managers, and engineering teams, as well as a dedicated cloud team to ensure secure, resilient infrastructure deployments. Contribute to engineering excellence through code reviews, mentor engineers, fostering a culture of excellence and performance. Who You Are You have deep production experience with Python and are proficient in designing serverless orchestrations using AWS Step Functions and AWS Lambda. You are experienced with graph databases, specifically Neo4j and the Cypher query language, and understand how to build and evolve data ontologies. You have experience building robust content-ingestion or ETL pipelines to extract and transform unstructured content (from sources like Git or Headless CMS) into graph databases. You have experience designing performant APIs for complex retrieval. Knowledge of GraphRAG patterns or vector embedding integration (e.g., via Amazon Bedrock) is a strong plus. You have a solid grasp of Infrastructure-as-Code (Pulumi) to manage your serverless pipelines, and you understand how to collaborate with cloud platform teams managing container workloads (Amazon EKS/Kubernetes). You're an excellent communicator, able to translate strategy into technical initiatives and represent technical points of view to both engineering and writing audiences. Terminal (POS) Certification Expert The IPP Security & Certifications team owns the certification portfolio that keeps Adyen's in-person payments infrastructure compliant and approved to operate. This role sits at the center of our Level 2 certification work. Adyen develops its own L2 kernels (contact & contactless), and you will own their certification end to end: coordinating type approval testing with our external certification lab, analyzing test results, and translating findings into clear, actionable reports for our kernel developers to work from. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. You will own the technical preparation and execution of Level 2 kernel certification , ensuring our kernels meet EMVCo type approval requirements as well as the contact and contactless specifications of Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, JCB, UnionPay, existing local payment method & planned future payment method expansions as Adyen's In-Person Payment business expands. You will sit directly between our external certification lab and our engineering teams. You will own the certification calendar : managing your own time and the wider timeline so submissions land when they need to, and so delta certifications triggered by kernel changes or expiring approvals never become a surprise. Experience with EMV Level 3 brand certification is a significant plus, as it gives you visibility into how kernel behavior surfaces in end-to-end scheme testing. You have strong EMV knowledge at the kernel level : EMVCo contact and contactless specifications, terminal application flow, CVM processing, and cryptogram generation. You are comfortable working with EMV test tooling and card simulators , and reading APDU traces to diagnose exactly where a transaction went wrong. You are an excellent communicator . You can explain a certification failure to an engineer in terms they can act on, and you can hold a productive technical conversation with an external lab and engage directly with payment schemes when needed, whether that's clarifying a test requirement or navigating a waiver request. You drive for results with a strong output mindset. Certifications have hard external dates , and you plan backward from them, keeping stakeholders aligned and the timeline visible without being chased. You take initiative. You spot problems before they escalate, own your own way of working, and don't wait to be told how to organize a certification cycle. You are as comfortable driving a project as you are analyzing a test result . title: Director, SME, Spain
category: SME & Growth Business; SME & Growth Management
description: ABOUT AIRWALLEX Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full. WHAT YOU’LL DO Spain is a key expansion market for our EMEA region and will play a critical role in achieving Airwallex’s commercial success in EMEA and globally. This role is a key part of the commercial leadership team in EMEA, driving strategic decision-making and ensuring alignment with broader regional objectives. It is responsible for launching and leading an SME & Growth team on the ground in Spain to achieve ambitious commercial aspirations, including acquiring new clients (frontbook) and managing existing clients (backbook) and driving upsells/cross-sells, and growing our presence to cement Airwallex as the market leader within the global banking and payments industry. RESPONSIBILITIES: - Hire, lead and inspire SME & Growth teams: Oversee Sales Development, Inbound/Outbound Sales, Account Management, and Channel Partnerships, driving them to exceed regional targets and deliver exceptional results. - Shape and execute commercial strategies: Develop and own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy, leveraging data, market insights, and key revenue channels to drive growth and profitability achieving annual OKRs. - Engage with customers and markets: Interface directly with customers and prospects, leading strategic deals and shaping customer-focused strategies with the global Product organisation. - Manage P&L and financial performance: Oversee the commercial contribution margin, budgets, and investments, ensuring financial goals are met while aligning incentive structures with global frameworks. - Build a high-performing team and culture: Recruit, empower, and retain top talent, foster a positive and high-performing team culture, and lead quarterly Sales Kick-Offs to align and inspire. - Enhance brand and drive strategic collaboration: Strengthen Airwallex’s brand in the Spanish market, represent the company at key events, and collaborate with regional and global teams to align on commercial strategies and campaigns. WHO YOU ARE We’re looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory. Ideally, you are an ambitious individual with sharp analytical skills, exceptional emotional intelligence and highly collaborative spirit. This role demands a track record of success and resilience in navigating ambiguity. You will be an owner and a builder, expected to be adaptable to changes as the business grows and scales. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: - Proven experience of at least 8 years in sales, revenue growth, or go-to-market leadership, including direct P&L ownership and driving cross-functional teams to achieve ambitious targets. - Demonstrated ability to build and scale high-performing teams in dynamic, high-growth environments, with a track record of fostering team engagement and success. - Strong analytical and data-driven approach to strategy formulation and execution, with experience in leveraging market and customer insights to optimise commercial outcomes. - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across diverse teams, influence global product strategies, and represent the organisation externally. - Strong Spanish market experience. - Native or fluent Spanish speaker. - Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: - A strong academic background, ideally from top-tier universities, complemented by early career success in consulting or other strategic roles. - Experience launching and scaling go-to-market teams in hyper-growth startups, particularly in the fintech or payments sectors. - Proven ability to navigate ambiguity and adapt quickly to evolving market conditions, demonstrating resilience and innovative problem-solving. APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page. Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

description: 您想在快节奏商务岗位上开启你的职业生涯吗？您想得到可以立即发挥个人影响力，并具备清晰职业发展道路的机会吗？如果是这样，我们的专员方案是您的理想选择。 AlphaSights公司简介 我们汇集了一批来自世界各地、满怀雄心壮志的人才，与顶级投资基金、战略咨询公司以及财富500强企业共事。我们共同努力，通过与全球各地细分领域专家建立联系，帮助客户取用专家知识、评估其决策能力并推动进步。 自2008年成立以来，我们经历了非凡的发展历程。我们有1,500多名专业人员遍布在全球九座城市，已牢固确立了市场领导地位，成为世界上增长最快的公司之一。我们坚持不懈追求卓越，因此我们只聘请最优秀、最聪明的毕业生，帮助我们再攀高峰。 如果您符合以下条件，请加入我们，为您的职业生涯插上腾飞的翅膀： 您能够在快节奏、注重结果的环境下茁壮成长 您擅于承受压力，喜欢在短时间之内完成任务 您意志坚强、充满韧性，随时准备卷起袖子大干一场 您希望利用自己的多语言技能，与多元化人才共事 您希望培养敏锐的商业触觉，跨越不同行业开展工作 工作内容 作为客户服务团队的专员，您将成为我们客户及其所寻求的专家知识之间的纽带。日常工作中，您将参与多个项目，这些项目来自顶尖客户机构的投资人、战略家与交易商，他们需要专家洞见为其决策提供依据。这是一个需要不断沟通的前线岗位，要求您在多个工作流之间同时进行切换。 您的职责将会包括： 招聘专家 ：您每天将会投入大量时间，通过电话和与客户项目高度匹配的专家进行沟通，通常时间很赶 了解 项目与市场背景 ，以及您的客户和专家所处的法律与监管环境 全面掌控 您的项目，从启动、管理客户与专家双方的沟通，到精心安排通话时间，从而确保双方合作无间 工作收获： 引领您 步入商业世界 ，而非局限于单一行业或职业。 帮助您 培养可以带走的商业能力和客户管理能力 ，涵盖专业沟通、谈判、说服、项目管理与时间管理等多个领域。 职位晋升路径明晰 ：入职24-30个月后有机会晋升为经理，约五年后有望晋升为副总裁。 成功通过Client Service Associate 岗位历练之后，您有资格申请本公司的 MBA学费资助计划 ，旨在为您在全球某些顶尖商学院学习提供财务支持。 岗位要求 每天您要以最佳状态投入工作。我们需要的人才如下： 本科学历，无需任何工作经历 学习成绩优异，平均学分绩点3.3或以上或成绩水准2:1或以上 中学与大学阶段课外活动表现优异 具有商业领域相关实习经验，可以证明对商业感兴趣 沟通技巧出色 专业的英语口语/写作能力，英语四级与六级成绩不低于 550分，雅思成绩不低于6.5分或GRE成绩不低于320分 薪酬福利 预估第一年总薪酬从 304,000元（平均绩效）到 406,700 元（出色绩效）不等，其中包括 (i) 192,000 元基本工资和 (ii) 基于个人业绩的薪酬（无上限） 十天年假 私人医疗保险、医疗基金和年度体检 每周五可选择居家办公

title: AI Engineer - COM INGLÊS
description: SOBRE A CAPCO A Capco é uma consultoria global de tecnologia e negócios, focada no setor de serviços financeiros e energia, somos apaixonados por ajudar nossos clientes, temos 40 escritórios nas Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico! Buscamos uma pessoa AI Engineer para projetar, desenvolver e evoluir funcionalidades assistidas por inteligência artificial dentro da plataforma, com foco em aplicações seguras, confiáveis e integradas aos processos de negócio. Principais responsabilidades Projetar e desenvolver copilotos, agentes e soluções conversacionais utilizando Microsoft Copilot Studio . Definir arquiteturas e estratégias de orquestração para agentes únicos e sistemas multiagentes. Desenvolver e otimizar prompts, instruções de sistema, ferramentas e fluxos de interação. Implementar estratégias de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) , grounding e gerenciamento de contexto. Integrar agentes e modelos de IA com APIs, bases de conhecimento, sistemas corporativos e fontes de dados. Avaliar a aplicação do Model Context Protocol (MCP) para conectar agentes a ferramentas, dados e serviços. Incorporar capacidades de IA em fluxos de trabalho e processos de negócio. Definir mecanismos de segurança, privacidade, controle de acesso e uso responsável da IA. Monitorar o desempenho das soluções e investigar falhas, alucinações e comportamentos inesperados. Documentar arquiteturas, prompts, integrações, limitações e critérios de avaliação. Conhecimento prático de Microsoft Copilot Studio ou plataformas equivalentes para criação de agentes. Domínio de engenharia de prompts, gerenciamento de contexto e uso de chamadas de ferramentas. Vivencia com estratégias de recuperação e contextualização, incluindo RAG, busca semântica e grounding. Conhecimento de design e orquestração de agentes de IA. Conhecimento com integração de APIs, serviços corporativos e fontes de dados. Conhecimento de práticas de governança, segurança, privacidade e uso responsável de IA. Conhecimento na criação de critérios, conjuntos de testes e métricas para avaliação de respostas geradas por IA. Capacidade de transformar requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas seguras e escaláveis. Boa comunicação para interagir com públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Conhecimento de Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, AI Search ou serviços equivalentes. Vivencia com Power Platform, Power Automate e Microsoft Dataverse. Conhecimento de frameworks de agentes e orquestração, como Semantic Kernel, AutoGen ou equivalentes. Experiência com bancos de dados vetoriais, embeddings, reranking e estratégias híbridas de busca. Conhecimento de observabilidade, tracing e monitoramento de aplicações de IA. Experiência com testes automatizados, red teaming e prevenção de ataques como prompt injection e vazamento de dados. Familiaridade com desenvolvimento em Python, C#, JavaScript ou TypeScript. Conhecimento de CI/CD, versionamento de prompts e práticas de LLMOps. Certificações Microsoft relacionadas a Azure AI, Copilot Studio ou Power Platform. POR QUE CAPCO: Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões. title: Líder Técnico
description: SOBRE A CAPCO A CAPCO é uma consultoria global de tecnologia e negócios, focada no setor de serviços financeiros e energia, somos apaixonados por ajudar nossos clientes, temos 40 escritórios nas Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico! Se criatividade e inovação são sua paixão, a CAPCO é ideal para você. Vamos te apoiar e ajudar a acelerar sua carreira! Estamos em busca de um(a) Líder Tecnico para crescer junto com a nossa equipe. Procuramos um profissional orientado para os detalhes, inteligente para os negócios, com vontade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e de ritmo acelerado, levando a empresa ao próximo nível de excelência! PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES : Liderar tecnicamente a implementação da Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) e do Adobe Real-Time CDP em uma grande seguradora brasileira. A pessoa será responsável por orientar a equipe na construção das integrações, ingestão e tratamento de dados, unificação de perfis, segmentação de audiências e ativação de casos de uso, assegurando a qualidade das entregas e a aplicação dos padrões técnicos definidos para a iniciativa. Atuará em parceria com o Delivery Manager, especialistas da Adobe e equipes do cliente para transformar requisitos de negócio em entregas técnicas, resolver impedimentos e dar visibilidade às dependências e aos riscos da implementação. Responsabilidades Liderança técnica: orientar desenvolvedores e especialistas, apoiar a distribuição das atividades, elaborar estimativas e contribuir para o planejamento das sprints. Implementação da AEP e do Real-Time CDP: conduzir a configuração e implementação de fontes de dados, schemas, datasets, identidades, perfis unificados, segmentos e audiências, conforme os casos de uso priorizados. Integrações e ingestão: coordenar a implementação de fluxos batch e em tempo real e das integrações com sistemas legados, CRM, canais digitais, data lake e plataformas de marketing. Qualidade das entregas: revisar configurações e soluções desenvolvidas, definir padrões de implementação, apoiar testes e atuar na investigação e resolução de problemas técnicos. Colaboração com o cliente: trabalhar com as áreas de arquitetura, segurança, dados e negócio para aplicar as diretrizes aprovadas e encaminhar decisões que dependam de validação dessas áreas. Apoio ao delivery: informar ao Delivery Manager o progresso das entregas, a capacidade técnica necessária, as dependências e os riscos; contribuir para o sequenciamento dos casos de uso e para a preparação das implantações. Documentação e capacitação: registrar decisões e procedimentos técnicos, compartilhar conhecimento e apoiar a evolução da equipe e dos profissionais do cliente. Conhecimentos técnicos obrigatórios Experiência prática na implementação da Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) e do Adobe Real-Time CDP . Conhecimento de Real-Time Customer Profile, Identity Service, Data Lake, Data Ingestion, Data Governance e Segmentation Service. Experiência com modelagem de schemas e datasets, ingestão batch e streaming, resolução de identidades, criação de segmentos e ativação de audiências. Experiência com integrações via APIs REST, autenticação OAuth 2.0/JWT e processamento orientado a eventos. Conhecimento de SQL, qualidade de dados, testes de integração e monitoramento de fluxos de dados. Vivência em práticas ágeis, revisão técnica e liderança de equipes multidisciplinares. Conhecimentos desejáveis Conhecimento de Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), Adobe Analytics, Query Service, Adobe Target, Adobe Workfront e Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). Boa compreensão de soluções de experiência digital baseadas em AEM , incluindo: Gestão e ciclo de vida de conteúdo; Abordagens headless e híbridas; Integração com plataformas de dados de clientes (CDP), personalização e analytics. Visão do ecossistema de experiência digital de ponta a ponta, abrangendo: CDPs e automação de marketing; Personalização e entrega de conteúdo, com foco em AEM; Integrações com CRM; Execução de campanhas de mídia e análise de resultados. Experiência com Azure, Databricks, Kafka, ETL/ELT e ambientes lakehouse. Vivência em seguradoras ou outras instituições financeiras, especialmente em iniciativas que envolvam dados de clientes, privacidade e governança. Certificações desejáveis Certificações Adobe Certified Expert , preferencialmente em AEM Sites e/ou AEM Assets, AJO, Adobe Analytics ou CJA, Adobe Real-Time CDP, Adobe Target ou Adobe Workfront. Competências esperadas Liderança técnica próxima da equipe, com capacidade de orientar a execução e apoiar a resolução de problemas. Facilidade para traduzir requisitos de negócio em atividades técnicas e entregas incrementais. Organização para gerir prioridades, dependências e riscos técnicos. Comunicação clara com equipes técnicas, áreas de negócio, especialistas Adobe e lideranças do cliente. Capacidade de facilitar discussões técnicas, construir consensos e apoiar a tomada de decisão. POR QUE CAPCO? Juntar-se à CAPCO significa ingressar em uma organização comprometida com um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo onde você é incentivado a #BeYourselfAtWork (Ser Você Mesmo no Trabalho). Celebramos a individualidade e reconhecemos que a diversidade e a inclusão, em todas as formas, são fundamentais para o sucesso. Acreditamos que todos trazem algo diferente, por isso adoraríamos saber o que o torna diferente! title: Recruitment Business Partner
description: Build Talent. Shape Growth. Capco is growing our business across Asia, and we're looking for a hands-on Talent Acquisition professional to join our Malaysia team and help us identify, engage and hire the talent that will support our continued growth. This is not a recruitment coordination role. You will own hiring end-to-end — from understanding the requirement and proactively identifying talent, through screening and stakeholder management, to offer and onboarding. You'll join a collaborative regional Talent Acquisition team where everyone remains close to recruitment delivery while also contributing to how we continuously improve the way we attract and hire talent. If you enjoy finding great people, navigating complex hiring requirements and working closely with business stakeholders in a fast-moving environment, we'd like to hear from you. Who We Are Capco is a global technology and business consultancy focused on the financial services industry. We combine deep industry expertise with consulting and technology capabilities to help our clients transform their businesses. Our work spans areas including: Banking, payments, wealth & asset management and capital markets Finance, risk, regulatory and compliance Data, digital and technology transformation Financial crime and core banking Emerging technologies and AI We value collaboration, entrepreneurship and diverse perspectives, and encourage our people to #BeYourselfAtWork . The Role As an Recruitment Business Partner , you will be a key member of our in-house Talent Acquisition team, managing recruitment across Capco's consulting business in Malaysia and supporting regional hiring requirements where needed. You will be responsible for the full recruitment lifecycle and will work directly with hiring managers and business stakeholders to translate demand into effective recruitment strategies. What You'll Do Own end-to-end recruitment across assigned roles, from requirement intake and sourcing through screening, interviews, offer management and onboarding. Build targeted talent pipelines using LinkedIn, job platforms, employee referrals, internal networks and other sourcing channels. Proactively identify and engage passive candidates rather than relying solely on inbound applications. Develop a strong understanding of Capco's business, consulting capabilities and talent requirements to improve candidate quality and hiring outcomes. Partner closely with hiring managers and senior stakeholders to understand requirements, calibrate profiles and provide market insights. Conduct recruiter screens to assess candidates for experience, capability, motivation and alignment with Capco's culture and opportunities. Manage candidates throughout the recruitment journey, maintaining a high-quality and responsive candidate experience. Coordinate closely with interviewers and stakeholders to maintain momentum, obtain timely feedback and progress candidates through the hiring process. Manage offers and candidate closing, including compensation discussions, notice periods and potential joining risks. Work with HR Operations and other internal teams to support a smooth offer-to-onboarding journey. Maintain accurate recruitment data and provide meaningful pipeline, conversion and hiring insights. Contribute to recruitment initiatives such as employee referrals, talent mapping, employer branding and process improvement. Collaborate with Talent Acquisition colleagues across Asia on regional hiring priorities and shared talent pools. What We're Looking For We're looking for someone who enjoys recruiting itself — sourcing, speaking with candidates, understanding the market and ultimately helping the business hire the right people. You will ideally have: 2–4+ years of recruitment experience within an in-house Talent Acquisition, RPO/MSP or recruitment agency environment. Demonstrated experience managing full-cycle recruitment. Strong hands-on sourcing capability, including experience identifying and engaging passive talent. Experience recruiting within financial services, consulting, technology or other professional-services environments is highly desirable. The ability to understand complex or evolving requirements and translate them into effective sourcing and candidate strategies. Strong candidate assessment and interviewing skills. Confidence working directly with hiring managers and senior stakeholders. Strong communication, relationship-management and influencing skills. The ability to manage multiple roles, candidates and priorities simultaneously in a fast-moving environment. A proactive and resourceful mindset — someone who identifies problems and takes ownership of solving them. Comfort working with recruitment data and using pipeline and conversion insights to improve hiring outcomes. Fluency in English. Mandarin and/or Cantonese would be advantageous, particularly for supporting selected regional hiring requirements. What Success Looks Like Success in this role isn't simply measured by the number of CVs generated. You'll help us build relevant, high-quality talent pipelines, move candidates effectively through the recruitment process, build trusted relationships with our stakeholders and deliver successful hires while creating a strong candidate experience. Over time, you'll also have opportunities to take ownership of broader Talent Acquisition initiatives and contribute to how we evolve our recruitment capability across the region. Why Capco? You'll join a collaborative environment where you'll have the opportunity to: Work closely with business leaders and experienced recruitment professionals. Recruit across diverse financial-services and consulting domains. Gain exposure to regional hiring and talent markets across Asia. Take meaningful ownership rather than operating within a narrowly defined recruitment process. Contribute ideas and help improve how we source, assess and engage talent. Develop your career as Capco's business and Talent Acquisition capability continue to evolve. If you're an experienced recruiter who enjoys being hands-on, commercially minded and close to both candidates and the business , we'd love to hear from you.

title: Technical & Functional Analyst
description: About Capco Capco is a global business and technology consultancy specializing in financial services. Together, you will help clients evolve applications and integrations that need to remain reliable while their technology landscape changes. The team combines detailed technical analysis with an understanding of how banking processes work in practice. The Role We are looking for a Functional & Technical Analyst who can investigate how applications work end to end and turn complex requirements into precise, implementable solution designs. You will sit close to the technology: analyzing APIs, data flows, application components and integrations across modern and legacy systems. Working with architects and development teams, you will define how systems should interact, challenge technical assumptions and help resolve issues through testing and production. Your functional understanding will help ensure that the solution also meets the underlying business need. Analyze and specify API integrations, including contracts, request and response structures, data mapping, error handling and interactions with back-end systems. Translate functional needs into detailed technical specifications, diagrams, user stories and acceptance criteria that developers and testers can work from. Work with solution architects and engineers to assess solution options, reuse existing services and identify integration constraints and technical risks. Investigate data and system behavior using SQL, API tools, application documentation and other available diagnostic information. Support integration and end-to-end testing, prepare test scenarios and data, and help teams resolve defects by tracing issues across system boundaries. Analyze production incidents, identify root causes and coordinate practical fixes with development and support teams. Maintain clear documentation of application architecture, interface behavior and changes throughout delivery and release. Collaborate with business stakeholders to validate that technical designs and delivered solutions meet their needs. What You Will Bring Experience in technical analysis, solution analysis or software engineering, with the ability to translate functional requirements into technical designs. Proven experience with APIs and system integration, including the analysis or design of API contracts and data exchanges between applications. Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases, with the ability to investigate data flows and troubleshoot issues. The ability to understand application architecture, trace end-to-end processing across multiple systems and document it clearly using diagrams and technical specifications. Experience supporting integration testing, defect analysis and the resolution of production issues. Familiarity with Agile software delivery and effective collaboration with architects, developers, testers and business stakeholders. Strong analytical and communication skills, with a structured approach to solving technically complex problems. Professional proficiency in Dutch or French and English, both spoken and written. Experience in banking or another regulated sector, and exposure to both modern services and legacy platforms, will be valuable. A background in Java or .NET environments, and familiarity with REST, Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman, UML, BPMN, Jira or Confluence, can help you get up to speed. Why Join Capco? At Capco, you can work on challenging transformation initiatives with leading financial institutions while developing your skills alongside experienced business and technology professionals. You will be part of an international, inclusive team that values curiosity, collaboration and the freedom to #BeYourselfAtWork. Ready to Take the Next Step? If you enjoy getting to the bottom of how systems work and designing integrations that hold up in practice, we would love to hear from you.

title: Software Engineer I - Backend | NextGen Engineering
description: Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires. Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan. We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster. About the team At Careem, the mission for the NextGen program is to help grow our new joint Engineering by learning how to write Clean Code, use SOLID principle techniques, and design reliable systems. The ultimate goal is to train the new Engineers to build Engineering excellence foundations with high standards. Our program covers all the areas of Careem tech be it Cyber Security, Data, Infrastructure, and all the Software Engineering tracks like Backend, Frontend as well as Mobile. We are looking for software engineers to join our team of talented engineers that share a common interest in distributed backend systems, their scalability, and continued development. You will work alongside a top talent for an accelerated learning path. You will have access to some of the most exciting projects and advanced tech for accelerated learning and exposure. You will be responsible for maintaining some of our services that power the Careem Engine, scaling highly distributed systems, and continuously documenting and improving our engineering practices. These large-scale, distributed systems handle everything from user requests to payment processing. What you'll do: Our tech stack is Java 8 and Spring Boot, Micro-Service Architecture, SQL and no-SQL DBs, and AWS infrastructure. Key responsibilities include: Development of our distributed backend system to meet the challenging functional, scalability, and reliability requirements for our fast-growing business. Maintain features and systems, with an emphasis on code quality, maintainability, readability, and testing. Facilitate collaboration with other engineers, product owners, and designers to solve interesting and challenging problems across our platform. Be a valued member of an autonomous, cross-functional agile team. You care about quality and you know what it means to ship high-quality code. What you'll need: Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply! The ideal candidate will have a passionate commitment to improving the lives of people, an insane focus on excellence and customer service, and a strong alignment with our core values: being bold, focused, agile and collaborative. Must have: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or other related technical fields. Understanding of Object-oriented design, data structures, and algorithms. Ability to solve complex problems. Must be able to write clean and maintainable code (must love coding!). Ability to effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions; deal with loosely defined problems and fast-changing requirements & think abstractly. Passionate about learning new technologies and working on a product of massive scale and impact. Able to communicate effectively. Attention to detail. Nice to have: Knowledge of AWS Knowledge of clean code principles Deep understanding of design patterns Demonstrated ability of test-driven development

title: Embedded Systems Test Engineer
description: Who we are: Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities. Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes. Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram . Who you are: We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Embedded Systems Test Engineer who will develop and maintain automated testing solutions to ensure the quality and reliability of software and embedded systems. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you! What you'll do: As a Embedded Systems Test Engineer , your key area of responsibility will be working closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to define and implement test strategies, automate manual tests, and integrate testing into the CI/CD pipeline . You will focus on creating, executing, and maintaining automated test scripts, managing test coverage, and optimizing testing tools and processes . Depending on the scope, this includes either embedded systems testing (hardware/software integration, real-time constraints, firmware) or software applications testing (web, mobile, desktop, regression, and smoke tests) . You will need to work closely with developers, product managers, and other technical teams . To be successful in this role, you will be a highly organized team player with excellent verbal and written communication skills, strong interpersonal relationship-building skills, and the ability to work well under pressure and respond to fast-changing priorities and deadlines . In addition, the successful candidate will have strong technical competence, solid knowledge of software development and QA practices, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously . How you'll make an impact: Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks for testing software applications (e.g., web, mobile, desktop) or embedded systems (e.g., firmware, device drivers, telematics hardware). Write automated test scripts in programming languages such as Python, Java, C++, or similar. Ensure these tests are integrated into the development pipeline to facilitate continuous testing and quality assurance. Define, design, and implement CI/CD pipelines to automate the build, test, and deployment process. Ensure smooth integration of automated tests into the overall development workflow. Manage test coverage for both functional and non-functional requirements. Ensure all new features and changes are properly tested. Work closely with developers, product managers, and other technical teams to identify testing requirements and define testing strategies. Provide guidance on test automation best practices. Build and maintain test environments, including setting up necessary tools and infrastructure for both software and embedded system testing. Ensure tools are up to date and aligned with industry best practices. For embedded systems, focus on hardware-software integration, real-time performance, memory constraints, and ensuring reliability and safety. For software applications, focus on validating performance, scalability, and functionality. Proactively monitor test results, logs, and system behavior. Identify issues early and report them in a structured manner. Develop scripts for log scraping and issue tracking automation. Stay current with industry trends, new testing technologies, and automation tools. Continuously improve test processes, automation frameworks, and methodologies to ensure better efficiency and effectiveness in testing. What you'll bring to this role: 1–5 years of required previous experience in QA Automation, Manual Testing, Security Testing, Performance Testing, Agile QA, or using Python/pytest to develop hardware-firmware automation test frameworks. 1+ years of experience working in embedded development and low-level programming (preferably using C). Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or an equivalent combination of education and work experience). Solid understanding of the core tenets of software development, QA practices/tools, and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab pipeline experience is a plus). Experience developing unit, integration, system, power, performance, and stress tests using automation Strong soft skills: highly organized, excellent written and verbal communication, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to handle fast-changing priorities under pressure Assets include experience with SCRUM, RTOS, Linux, GCP, BigQuery, and SQL. If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees. How we work: At Geotab, we have adopted a flexible hybrid working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support both in-person and virtual work. However, you are welcomed and encouraged to come into our beautiful, safe, clean offices as often as you like. When working from home, you are required to have a reliable internet connection with at least 50mb DL/10mb UL. Virtual work is supported with cloud-based applications, collaboration tools and asynchronous working. The health and safety of employees are a top priority. We encourage work-life balance and keep the Geotab culture going strong with online social events, chat rooms and gatherings. Join us and help reshape the future of technology! We believe that ensuring diversity is fundamental to our future growth and progress and is an integral part of our business. We believe that success happens where new ideas can flourish – in an environment that is rich in diversity and a place where people from various backgrounds can work together. Geotab encourages applications from all qualified individuals. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities during the recruitment and assessment processes and when people are hired. We will ensure the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities are taken into account as part of performance management, career development, training and redeployment processes. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information about our diversity and inclusion as well as accommodation policies and practices, please contact us at careers@geotab.com. By submitting a job application to Geotab Inc. or its affiliates and subsidiaries (collectively, “Geotab”), you acknowledge Geotab’s collection, use and disclosure of your personal data in accordance with our Privacy Policy . Impulsionados pela tecnologia, conectamos perfeitamente pessoas, veículos, cargas e estradas, movendo coisas importantes e trazendo benefícios para as comunidades locais em 11 mercados na Ásia e na América Latina. Profissional sênior e referência técnica na condução de estratégias de Contas a Pagar e Tesouraria, diretamente responsável pela maximização da saúde financeira, gestão de liquidez de médio/longo prazo e mitigação de riscos corporativos. Liderar e otimizar processos de conciliação de fornecedores críticos, faturas complexas e operações financeiras de grande porte. Definir, revisar e auditar as políticas de fluxo de aprovação de pagamentos, limites de alçada e estrito compliance financeiro. Desenhar e implementar estratégias globais de mitigação de riscos operacionais, tributários e de liquidez na tesouraria. title: Driver Operations Associate (Fleet Onboarding | 6-month contract)
description: Lalamove is disrupting the logistics industry by connecting customers and drivers directly through our technology. We offer customers a lightning fast and convenient way to book delivery and moving services whether they are at their home, at work or on the go. People talk about O2O, we live it! Currently, Lalamove is a leading global on-demand delivery platform with millions of delivery partners serving millions of orders everyday. With 1600+ employees spread across SEA and LATAM, our 10-year old company has reached unicorn status in 2018, is well funded by prominent VCs and has kept growing at tremendous speed since. Our strength lies in our internal values, namely Passion in serving local communities, empowering SMEs and our driver partners, Execution and Grit because that is how we differentiate ourselves by never giving up and striving for excellence, and Humility - awareness in ourselves to learn from others and never stop improving. At Lalamove, we strongly believe in the power of community. Millions of drivers and customers use our technology every day to connect with one another and move things that matter. Delivery is what we do best and we ensure it is always fast and simple. Since 2013, we have tackled the logistics industry head on to find the most innovative solutions for the world’s delivery needs. Our vision is to bring communities closer and make city life easier by allowing fast and convenient circulation of goods. We realize this vision with a ‘glocal’ approach, building a robust operations team to adapt our product to local networks of businesses and delivery contractors. At the same time, we have ambition to build an international brand by establishing an even more global presence. We are looking for an enthusiastic and resourceful Driver Community & Fleet Acquisition Associate to strengthen Lalamove’s presence within the local driver and automotive ecosystem. This is a field focused role for someone who enjoys meeting people, exploring new opportunities and building relationships on the ground. You will act as the company’s eyes and ears in the market, identifying potential driver supply partners, gathering feedback from drivers and uncovering new channels through which we can grow our driver community. You do not need to be an automotive or logistics expert from day one. However, you should be commercially aware, willing to learn and able to communicate confidently with people at different levels, from individual drivers-operators to fleet owners, association representatives and business decision-makers. What You’ll Do: Scout, engage and onboard fleet owners, transport operators, car rental companies and other businesses with access to potential drivers and vehicles. Identify and build relationships with key referrers, industry influencers, driver-community leaders and relevant trade or automotive associations. Prospect and develop new driver acquisition channels, including automotive workshops, driving schools, vehicle dealers, rental operators and online or offline driver communities. Promote Lalamove’s Driver-Refer-Driver programme to external drivers and potential referrers, clearly explaining its benefits, mechanics and eligibility requirements. Develop and manage referrer and affiliate activities that generate consistent, high-quality driver leads and registrations. Regularly engage drivers on the ground to understand their experience, concerns and operational challenges, and provide structured feedback and market insights to the internal team. Monitor competitor activities, driver incentives and market developments to help ensure that Lalamove’s driver-acquisition initiatives remain relevant and competitive. Build relationships with car clubs, automotive communities and event organisers to identify suitable events, gatherings and sponsorship or partnership opportunities. Support the planning and execution of field activations, automotive events and community-engagement initiatives to increase Lalamove’s visibility within the driver community. Respond to driver and partner enquiries and work with internal teams to resolve onboarding issues or other points of friction. Maintain accurate records of prospects, engagements, leads, onboarding progress and field feedback, and provide regular updates on outcomes and opportunities. What we seek: An outgoing and open-minded individual who can build rapport and influence people from different age groups, nationalities, professions and backgrounds. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the confidence to engage both individual drivers and business owners or senior decision-makers. A hands-on, street-smart and resourceful approach, with a willingness to spend time in the field identifying and pursuing opportunities. A strong sense of curiosity and awareness, with the ability to listen to drivers, recognise market opportunities and translate ground-level observations into useful insights. A go-getter attitude with the initiative to propose practical ideas and solutions based on operational and market needs. Strong prioritisation and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple leads, relationships and activities without compromising quality. An autonomous and adaptable attitude suited to a fast-changing working environment. The discipline to follow company processes and SOPs while providing accurate, complete and appropriate information to drivers and external partners. A results-oriented mindset, with ownership of leads from initial engagement through onboarding and activation. What You’ll Need: Diploma or higher in any field is preferred but not mandatory. Previous experience in field sales, business development, driver acquisition, community engagement, fleet management or partner recruitment would be an advantage. Familiarity with the local driver, automotive, transport or logistics community would be beneficial but is not required. Comfortable with frequent fieldwork and attending relevant community or automotive events when required. Basic proficiency in tracking leads, preparing updates and using standard digital communication and productivity tools. A valid driving licence and access to personal transportation would be an advantage.

We offer customers a lightning fast and convenient way to book delivery and moving services whether they are at their home, at work or on the go. People talk about O2O, we live it! Currently, Lalamove is a leading global on-demand delivery platform with millions of delivery partners serving millions of orders everyday. With 1600+ employees spread across SEA and LATAM, our 10-year old company has reached unicorn status in 2018, is well funded by prominent VCs and has kept growing at tremendous speed since. Our strength lies in our internal values, namely Passion in serving local communities, empowering SMEs and our driver partners, Execution and Grit because that is how we differentiate ourselves by never giving up and striving for excellence, and Humility - awareness in ourselves to learn from others and never stop improving. At Lalamove, we strongly believe in the power of community. Millions of drivers and customers use our technology every day to connect with one another and move things that matter. Delivery is what we do best and we ensure it is always fast and simple. Since 2013, we have tackled the logistics industry head on to find the most innovative solutions for the world’s delivery needs. Our vision is to bring communities closer and make city life easier by allowing fast and convenient circulation of goods. We realize this vision with a ‘glocal’ approach, building a robust operations team to adapt our product to local networks of businesses and delivery contractors. At the same time, we have ambition to build an international brand by establishing an even more global presence. We are looking for an enthusiastic and resourceful Driver Community & Fleet Acquisition Associate to strengthen Lalamove’s presence within the local driver and automotive ecosystem. This is a field focused role for someone who enjoys meeting people, exploring new opportunities and building relationships on the ground. You will act as the company’s eyes and ears in the market, identifying potential driver supply partners, gathering feedback from drivers and uncovering new channels through which we can grow our driver community. You do not need to be an automotive or logistics expert from day one. However, you should be commercially aware, willing to learn and able to communicate confidently with people at different levels, from individual drivers-operators to fleet owners, association representatives and business decision-makers. What You’ll Do: Scout, engage and onboard fleet owners, transport operators, car rental companies and other businesses with access to potential drivers and vehicles. Identify and build relationships with key referrers, industry influencers, driver-community leaders and relevant trade or automotive associations. Prospect and develop new driver acquisition channels, including automotive workshops, driving schools, vehicle dealers, rental operators and online or offline driver communities. Promote Lalamove’s Driver-Refer-Driver programme to external drivers and potential referrers, clearly explaining its benefits, mechanics and eligibility requirements. Develop and manage referrer and affiliate activities that generate consistent, high-quality driver leads and registrations. Regularly engage drivers on the ground to understand their experience, concerns and operational challenges, and provide structured feedback and market insights to the internal team. Monitor competitor activities, driver incentives and market developments to help ensure that Lalamove’s driver-acquisition initiatives remain relevant and competitive. Build relationships with car clubs, automotive communities and event organisers to identify suitable events, gatherings and sponsorship or partnership opportunities. Support the planning and execution of field activations, automotive events and community-engagement initiatives to increase Lalamove’s visibility within the driver community. Respond to driver and partner enquiries and work with internal teams to resolve onboarding issues or other points of friction. Maintain accurate records of prospects, engagements, leads, onboarding progress and field feedback, and provide regular updates on outcomes and opportunities. What we seek: An outgoing and open-minded individual who can build rapport and influence people from different age groups, nationalities, professions and backgrounds. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the confidence to engage both individual drivers and business owners or senior decision-makers. A hands-on, street-smart and resourceful approach, with a willingness to spend time in the field identifying and pursuing opportunities. A strong sense of curiosity and awareness, with the ability to listen to drivers, recognise market opportunities and translate ground-level observations into useful insights. A go-getter attitude with the initiative to propose practical ideas and solutions based on operational and market needs. Strong prioritisation and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple leads, relationships and activities without compromising quality. An autonomous and adaptable attitude suited to a fast-changing working environment. The discipline to follow company processes and SOPs while providing accurate, complete and appropriate information to drivers and external partners. A results-oriented mindset, with ownership of leads from initial engagement through onboarding and activation. What You’ll Need: Diploma or higher in any field is preferred but not mandatory. Previous experience in field sales, business development, driver acquisition, community engagement, fleet management or partner recruitment would be an advantage. Familiarity with the local driver, automotive, transport or logistics community would be beneficial but is not required. Comfortable with frequent fieldwork and attending relevant community or automotive events when required. Basic proficiency in tracking leads, preparing updates and using standard digital communication and productivity tools. A valid driving licence and access to personal transportation would be an advantage.

title: Compliance Analyst, Financial Crime Compliance QA
description: Who We Are At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more. About the Team The Financial Crime Quality Assurance (QA) team at OKX is responsible for maintaining and enhancing the quality of financial crime investigations across the business. We are a team of risk-focused professionals who independently assess investigation quality, promote consistency in decision-making, and ensure compliance with AML/CFT requirements, internal policies, and regulatory expectations. By working closely with Operations, Product, and Compliance teams, we help strengthen financial crime controls and drive continuous improvement across the investigation lifecycle. About the Opportunity This is an exciting opportunity to join the Compliance Assurance Function of a regulated crypto business. As a QA Analyst, you will be responsible for conducting quality reviews of financial crime investigations, assessing investigator decision-making, and ensuring compliance with AML/CFT requirements, internal policies, and quality standards. You will work closely with Operations, Team Leads, and Product teams to drive continuous improvement, strengthen investigation quality, and support the effectiveness of the firm’s financial crime controls. What You’ll Be Doing Quality Reviews – Conduct daily independent QA reviews of investigator and Sanctions casework, including Transaction Monitoring, Name Screening, EDD, and other AML investigations. Evaluate accuracy, completeness, adherence to AML/CFT policies, regulatory requirements, internal procedures, and the quality of case narratives. Assess whether investigative decisions are well-supported, risk-based, and appropriately documented, including escalation and disposition outcomes. Identify defects, document findings, and provide clear, constructive feedback to investigators and team leads. Stakeholder Collaboration – Partner closely with the Financial Crimes Operations team, Team Leads, Product teams, and other stakeholders to communicate QA findings, discuss quality trends, resolve process gaps, and ensure consistent interpretation of policies and quality standards. Build strong relationships across AML and other cross-functional teams to support a holistic approach to compliance and risk management. Quality Calibration & Internal QA Meetings – Participate in and facilitate regular QA calibration sessions to review complex or borderline cases, discuss grey areas, align on scoring methodology, and ensure consistency in quality evaluations across the QA team. Share key findings, emerging typologies, regulatory expectations, and best practices to improve review quality and reduce subjectivity. Performance Monitoring & Reporting – Monitor investigator quality performance, analyze QA findings and recurring error trends, and prepare regular quality reports and dashboards. Identify systemic issues, emerging risks, root causes, and opportunities to strengthen controls and support management decision-making. Coaching & Quality Improvement – Provide timely and actionable feedback to investigators and team leads to improve investigation quality, strengthen analytical skills, and enhance case documentation. Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for AML investigations by providing guidance on complex or high-risk cases, typologies, and regulatory expectations. Support remediation activities by validating corrective actions and tracking quality improvements over time. Policy & Process Compliance – Ensure all reviews are conducted in accordance with internal AML/CFT policies, regulatory requirements, quality frameworks, and standard operating procedures. Escalate potential compliance risks, control weaknesses, or systemic issues identified during QA reviews. Continuous Improvement & QA Framework – Support continuous improvement by recommending enhancements to investigation procedures, QA methodologies, workflows, scorecards, sampling frameworks, training materials, and quality controls. Contribute to AI-enabled quality tools such as QA Copilot and participate in UAT, process validation, and implementation of new quality initiatives. AML Projects & Program Enhancements – Participate in AML-related projects, initiatives, and program enhancements as required. Provide QA expertise and support cross-functional initiatives aimed at strengthening AML controls, processes, and overall program effectiveness. Ad Hoc Responsibilities – Perform additional assignments and special projects as delegated by the supervisor, including process improvement initiatives, training support, root cause analysis, documentation updates, and cross-functional projects to strengthen the overall quality program. What We Look For In You Bachelor's degree in law, finance, business administration or a related field; a relevant compliance certification (e.g. ICA, CAMS) is an advantage Prior experience in a compliance, legal or regulatory role within financial services, fintech or crypto industry is preferred Strong understanding of AML/CFT regulations, financial crime investigations, transaction monitoring, and QA methodologies, with the ability to evaluate investigation quality, assess decision-making, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and quality standards Strong analytical ability, with the capacity to assess regulatory obligations, identify gaps and produce well-reasoned written analysis High attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records and produce consistent, high-quality documentation Fluent in English with clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to convey compliance requirements to non-specialist colleagues Strong organisational skills, able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, prioritise effectively and meet regulatory deadlines Comfortable operating with limited supervision, escalating appropriately when required Perks & Benefits Competitive total compensation package L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development Various team building programs and company events Wellness and meal allowances Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants More that we love to tell you along the process!
